cCollisionReconciliation.explanation: S378/S380's two original C base collisions remain reproducible. The complete S390 Chromium measurement also exposes collarLeafDepth=max as a third unkeyed-baseline collision. All three rows fail only with the inline C callout; the approved source-centered C plus complete keyed schedule has zero keyed renderer failures across all 17 rows. They remain baseline comparator evidence, not current keyed-output blockers.

priorInlineLeaderReconciliation.note: S385 counts describe the prior inline-leader rendering. S390 confirms ten source POMs are represented by eight source-centered stations (including co-located/shared-key POMs) with full schedule rows; those old leader crossings are not emitted leader paths in the keyed output. Current key-to-source geometry contacts are separately reviewed in S391 and are not accepted by this reconciliation.
